description:
**A comical, twisted, parenting romance that requires a miracle!**

A reclusive loner, social misfit, avoidant personality disorder, and best novelist 'Gong-Jeong' is faced with newborn twins?! What a bolt from the blue! Before Gong-Jeong can even blame his mother for leaving the twins behind, he has to deal with the newborns who cry loudly! Gong-Jeong, who is at a loss and hesitating, is helped by his editor friend, Boo Seung-Hyun, who finds a babysitter. That's how 'Igi-Jeok', the god of parenting, appears. Can Gong-Jeong, who hates people so much, team up with Igi-Jeok to raise newborn twins? 

A twisted and tumultuous parenting romance where two people who met as fate when they were young raise twins together and establish new understandings about life, life, and human relationships! 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
